title: Wall Mount Towel Bar 30-Inch Solid Brass Carolina Collection | Oil Rubbed Bronze | Allied Brass
short_title: Wall Mount Towel Bar 30-Inch | Allied Brass, Oil Rubbed Bronze
description:
Upgrade bathroom storage with a 30-Inch wall mount towel bar crafted from solid brass for reliable everyday use in Oil Rubbed Bronze, which offers rich, dark brown tones with subtle copper highlights, bringing Old World character to any bathroom. Designed as part of the Carolina Collection, this straight bar helps keep towels within reach while saving space.

Highlights:
- Oil Rubbed Bronze brings rich depth and character
- Choose from 25 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean, finished look
- Mounting plates and installation hardware included
- Coordinates with other versatile bath accessories in the Carolina Collection

Specs:
- Collection: Carolina Collection
- Style: Traditional
- Bar shape: Straight bar
- Center-to-center: 30 in
- Bar diameter: 0.75 in
- Overall size: 30 in L x 2 in W x 3.5 in H
- Projection: 2 in
- Weight capacity: 10 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Included: Towel bar, mounting plates, and all installation hardware
Multiple designer finishes available
